text: [color=deep_sky_blue]Bopp Clicker[/color] is an incremental game, where you click on the character in the center of the screen (named [color=light_green]Bopp[/color]), and get money from doing that.

The gameplay in a nutshell is that you buy upgrades that just add more money per click, then you start buying idle clicking upgrades that click for you, and only then can you unlock [color=deep_sky_blue]the Nodes mechanic[/color], which is explained below in the Nodes chapter.
There are two types of upgrades: the one that adds a multiplier (more coins per click), and the one that clicks for you (idle clicking).

Upgrades also have a [color=peach_puff]set maximum level[/color], above which you cannot go. And they [color=peach_puff]become more expensive[/color] after each level up (actual percentage varies by upgrade).

The last five upgrades are designed for the end game and they are pretty expensive and have high maximum levels. You have to use [color=deep_sky_blue]the Nodes mechanic[/color] in order to generate that amount of money.

First, buy a slot (Slot 0 is the cheapest), and then in the configuration menu (accessible via CONFIGURE button), set the Provided coins value to something like 50. ([color=crimson]also check that you have atleast 50 coins on your balance[/color])

Then you have to place [color=peach_puff]the input node[/color] in the beginning, [color=peach_puff]output node[/color] in the end and connect their inputs and outputs. But for now it does not generate no money.
In order to start making money, you have to place [color=peach_puff]the processor node[/color] in the middle (so now input node goes to processor node which goes to the output node).

description: <- Use this placement to generate money

text: The processor node will start at the first level, generating only 20% profit. But once you start getting more and more money, you can level up the processor node and the profits will only increase!

To expand your coin generating facility, you can buy more slots and you can also have multiple processor nodes per slot. ([color=crimson]don't forget to level the slot up once you hit the max node cap![/color])
Welp, looks like you have maxed out on every upgrade and every node slot has atleast 50 processor nodes.
The ultimate goal of the game is getting [color=yellow]one trillion coins[/color].

For now, the game provides a fairly extensive modding support: you can add new upgrades, use mod scripts for custom behavior, and other things.
All of that is parsed from JSON files in user://data directory (%appdata%/BoppClicker/data for Windows).
